children.game_version: Simplified routine focusing on following the leader.

seniors.seated_version: Perform arm movements while seated, focusing on rhythm and range of motion.
seniors.standing_version: Perform with reduced tempo and minimal footwork.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Primary focus; complex, rhythmic gestures synchronized with the music.
movement_profile.footwork: Minimal; side-to-side stepping, stepping in place, and occasional hops.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Synchronized group formation, usually facing forward.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Subtle hip movements and torso engagement to complement arm gestures.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Occasional hops or jumps, but generally low-impact.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, energetic, and ready for rapid arm movement.

signature_moves.description: The iconic, pre-choreographed routine performed during the chorus of a song.
signature_moves.name: Sabi choreography

music_profile.sound_description: Fast-paced, high-energy electronic music characterized by driving synth melodies and a steady, rhythmic kick drum.

basic_steps: Hand gestures synchronized to the beat
teaching.formation: Synchronized group formation, often in lines or facing the DJ booth
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start by learning the 'sabi' (chorus) of a song, as it is the most repetitive and iconic part of the routine.
